value.rationale: Gear graphs are a classical natural wheel-subdivision family. The explicit size-dependent zero-primary Jordan shape includes an unexpected fusion in the twice-odd case, exact transient populations for every size, a sharp power-of-two extinction phenomenon, and full arithmetic primitive recurrence counts. These are motivated and nontrivial dynamical invariants, unlike a single arbitrary numerical example.
